tha-ap311:1.1: Buddhasaññaka.] Udentaṃ sataraṃsīva vītaraṃsaṃ va bhāṇumaṃ / vanantaragataṃ santaṃ lokajetthaṃ narāsabhaṃ // //
tha-ap311:2.1: Addasaṃ supinantena Siddhatthaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā sugatim upapajj' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap311:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ saññam alabhiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap311:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Buddhasaññako thero i. g. a-ti.
